x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"meeting_attendee_record\":{\"status\":\"Present\",\"login_information_id\":999}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/meeting_attendee_records?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&meeting_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
